title: The published CI lane does not bind an authorized model connection to Core
conclusion: No already-published CI bootstrap was found that the WP12 driver omitted. The installed Core supports real environment connections and its existing credential database; the current test lane does not provide either. A WP12 driver change cannot establish that external authorization.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: For provider metadata that declares environment names, register real key and environment integration methods. Catalog metadata is not a connection.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: A real owner-authorized integration connection must be present in the runner process.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: resolveConnections combines stored credentials with declared environment methods whose process environment value exists; resolving an env connection reads that value.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: Existing provider connection or explicitly provisioned runner credential. No environment value was inspected in this investigation.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: Core reads its own credential database and, where allowed, an existing release database. It does not obtain credentials from the GitHub connection used to publish this branch.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: An authorized Core credential database must already exist in the actual runner environment. The published dependency cache does not restore it.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: GitHub-hosted runner, dependency setup and exact test request. No provider credential, model account, Core credential database or trust provisioning step is declared.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: CI/host owner must publish or identify an approved binding before a real native execution can be attempted.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: The only request environment keys are ORCHESTRA_EXPERIMENTAL_OMNI_SPAWNER and ORCHESTRA_CHANNEL. config is accepted only for the named Playwright configurations.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: The existing .ci-run.json interface cannot carry a model credential or Core provider configuration.

sourceToPrecondition.behavior: model.available filters by provider availability and enabled model. The driver queries this before runner support filtering and the C15 intersection.
sourceToPrecondition.precondition: At least one actual available, supported model must also be published by services.models().

installedMechanismsExamined.reason: No provider variable is forwarded by the workflow, and the request validator rejects additional environment keys.
No published setup, volume or cache restores that installation-owned database to the GitHub-hosted process; actual credentials were not probed.
Exact W19 workflows directory contains only astra-wp12-check.yml and test-ci.yml. At pinned dev a1d37698 the product-test lane also has no provider injection.
ModelsDevPlugin deliberately excludes zero-input-cost OpenCode models; Catalog rejects the public-key path and OpencodePlugin loads provider config only from a real connection.

facts: Uses the Location returned by createSfHostRuntime.
Location service construction waits for installed plugin boot.
Observes actual available and supported models and intersects with actual host-published models.
Fails a supported-versus-published mismatch; does not inject a provider or synthesize an accepted receipt.

observedExecution.observation: Both initial and reopened verifier-negative harness observations have available=[], supported=[], published=[], intersection=[].
observedExecution.scope: Existing W18 runtime observation, not a W19 or W20 execution result.

ownerAction.request: Identify or publish an approved CI execution binding to an existing real provider/account for the actual Core Location, using the provider's normal integration mechanism and retaining the existing test/authority guardrails. Provide the source pin and the runner input contract without publishing secret values.
ownerAction.wp12Continuation: Consume the published binding, then run the exact outstanding native mission scopes. Reuse the existing real Session/SkillLoadReceipt/output/consumer paths; preserve unavailable as unavailable until that execution is observed.
ownerAction.completionBoundary: A connection only unlocks execution attempts. It does not itself satisfy 18 skills, five profiles, 39 routes, contribution verification or real consumer acceptance.

limits: The observations do not prove the raw metadata catalog is empty or name a missing secret.
No repository-secret, organization-secret, actual credential store or environment-secret value was read.
This finding does not authorize changing identity, finance, deployment, CI secrets or provider trust.
